item.title: South Carolina House Approves Reclassification of Abortion Medications
item.description: Following an extensive five-hour debate, the South Carolina House of Representatives granted second reading approval to a bill that reclassifies common abortion medications as controlled substances. The legislation aims to criminalize the distribution of these drugs when obtained through online services or from out-of-state providers. The bill designates medications like mifepristone and misoprostol as Schedule […]

item.title: York County Restaurant Inspections: Five Kitchens Cited in January
item.description: YORK COUNTY, S.C. – State health inspectors visited 193 dining establishments across York County in January 2026. While the vast majority of local kitchens met safety standards with “A” grades, five establishments received lower ratings due to violations ranging from temperature control issues to improper food storage and labeling. item.title: Lancaster County Restaurant Inspections: Three Kitchens Receive ‘B’ Grades in January
item.description: LANCASTER, S.C. – State health inspectors conducted 82 inspections of local dining establishments across Lancaster County in January 2026. While the vast majority of local kitchens received “A” grades, three establishments were downgraded to a “B” rating due to violations involving temperature control, sanitizer concentrations, and food storage safety.
